repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-ai-assistant
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.aiassistant. register() connects the shared mercury socket and listens for assistant-api events; makeAiAssistantRequest and four meeting helpers (summarizeMeeting, wasMyNameMentioned, showAllActionItems, askMeAnything) POST a chunked request to the assistant-api service, encrypting question text with the caller's KMS key, and resolve with a requestId, sessionId, and streamEventName. Response chunks arriving over mercury are decrypted by content type and re-emitted on the aiassistant:stream event named for that requestId, with a plugin-generated timeout event when no chunk arrives within requestTimeout. It stores nothing.

ai-assistant-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.ts; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers AIAssistant as internal plugin 'aiassistant' with config {aiassistant: {requestTimeout: 60000}}; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default AIAssistant class. webex.internal.aiassistant exposes register, unregister, makeAiAssistantRequest, summarizeMeeting, wasMyNameMentioned, showAllActionItems, and askMeAnything, and emits aiassistant:registered, aiassistant:unregistered, aiassistant:activityReceived, and aiassistant:stream:<requestId>; specified in src/docs/README.md.

assistant-api-http.source: assistant-api service (catalog service name assistant-api in src/constants.ts; route definitions are not in this repository)
assistant-api-http.summary: POST sessions/messages (first request) or sessions/<sessionId>/messages with JSON body {clientRequestId, async: 'chunked', locale, content: {context: {resources}, encryptionKeyUrl, type, value, parameters?}, entryPoint?, assistant?} and optional header AI-Assistant-Render-Protocol. The response body (id, url, sessionId, sessionUrl, creatorId, createdAt) is returned to the caller with requestId and streamEventName added.

assistant-api-mercury-events.source: assistant-api service events delivered over mercury (event names in src/constants.ts; service definitions are not in this repository)
assistant-api-mercury-events.summary: event:assistant-api.response envelopes carry data {clientRequestId, finished, responseType, response: {content: {name, value, ...}, errorMessage?, errorCode?, sessionId, messageId, ...}}; content.name is one of message, cited_answer, schedule_meeting, tool_result, tool_use, workspace. The plugin also listens on the bare name assistant-api.activity for data {activity: {content: {value: {message}}, encryptionKeyUrl}}, which mercury never emits under that name.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerInternalPlugin keys the plugin by its raw name (aiassistant, first registration wins) and merges its config into the defaults; WebexPlugin supplies webex, logger, config (webex.config[namespace.toLowerCase()]), and the ampersand-events listenTo, stopListening, trigger, and on; webex.request resolves service assistant-api through the service catalog; webex.canAuthorize proxies the credentials.

internal-plugin-mercury-events.source: @webex/internal-plugin-mercury (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/docs/README.md, found stale on the session model; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/mercury.js)
internal-plugin-mercury-events.summary: Imported for its registration side effect. connect() resolves at once when connected and shares one socket per webex instance; inbound envelopes are emitted as event, event:<namespace>, and event:<eventType>, so assistant-api.response arrives as event:assistant-api.response. off(name) without a handler removes every listener for that name.

internal-plugin-encryption-kms.summary: webex.internal.encryption.encryptText(keyUrl, plaintext) and decryptText(keyUrl, ciphertext) resolve strings and reject on KMS or JOSE errors. Not declared in this package's package.json and not registered by any import of this package; the host bundle must provide it.

common-timers-timer.summary: Timer(callback, timeout) with start (only from init), reset and cancel (only while running); an undefined timeout fires immediately. Used for the per-request inactivity timeout.

uuid.summary: uuid.v4 generates the requestId (clientRequestId) when the caller supplies none.

lodash.summary: get and set address response fields by path for decryption; merge builds the stream event payload.
